Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Bromodomain-containing protein 4. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target name 'Bromodomain-containing protein 4' and target organism 'Homo sapiens'. Filter standard_type to 'IC50' and standard_relation to '='. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
